summary.text: Sequanna Taylor is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 11, where she took office on January 6, 2025, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Shandowlyon Hendricks Reaves.
She previously served on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors and the Milwaukee Public Schools Board of School Directors.

paragraphs.text: Sequanna Taylor earned a high school diploma from South Division High School and a bachelor's degree from Concordia University in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as CEO of Open Arms Inc. and Taylor Legacies, as a parent engagement specialist for Milwaukee Public Schools, and as an educator.

She has served as president of the Milwaukee Educational Assistant Association, as an executive board member of the Milwaukee Teachers Education Association and as a member of the National Education Association board of directors.
Taylor served on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors from 2016 to 2026 and on the Milwaukee Public Schools Board of School Directors for District 3 from 2019 to 2022.
She joined the Assembly in January 2025 and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Audit, Criminal Justice and Public Safety, and Joint Legislative Audit committees.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she listed her campaign's key messages as reentry, supporting youth and seniors, and health and human needs.
